_doc: DJ mode mood presets (core/dj.py). desc is what the set is built for (it goes into the one Claude call per set); aliases are other words that pick it ("play something for the gym", "put on some coding music"). Moods you save by voice ("save this vibe as late night") go to ~/.local/share/jarvis/dj/moods.json, untracked, and are merged with these.

studying.desc: music for studying: steady and unobtrusive, mostly instrumental or soft vocals, no sudden drops or shouting, energy low to medium and even

focus.desc: deep focus for coding or writing: instrumental, driving but not distracting, electronic / lo-fi / post-rock / ambient leaning, medium energy that holds

gym.desc: gym workout: high energy, hard-hitting, big beats and drops, keep the tempo up the whole way, peak in the middle

gaming.desc: gaming session: energetic and immersive, electronic, rock, hip hop and soundtracks, steady high energy without lyrics that pull focus

chill.desc: relaxed and mellow, easy listening, warm and unhurried, low energy

party.desc: party: upbeat crowd-pleasers, danceable, energy building through the set

late night.desc: late night: moody, atmospheric, slower, a bit dark and intimate

driving.desc: driving: open-road feel, upbeat, sing-along friendly, steady groove

sleep.desc: winding down to sleep: very calm, soft, slow, ambient or acoustic, getting quieter through the set

morning.desc: morning: bright, optimistic, gently building energy
